card.name: Radiation dose units in dosimetry tables
card.fires_on: Radiation units such as rads, rem, MBq and mGy in dosimetry tables and activity amounts (mCi/MBq). Also fires on a few words after a number, such as 'across' or 'more'.

modes.label: Radiation units
modes.description: The unit word or its last letters in absorbed-dose or activity expressions.

modes.label: Activity in MBq
modes.description: The final letter of MBq after a number in injected-activity ranges.

modes.label: Word after a quantity
modes.description: A scale or extent word following a number, outside dosimetry.
